messages.text:
The drawer visibility fix worked too aggressively in validation: the sidebar is hidden when closed, but the smoke test is not reliably opening it after route/viewport transitions.

I’m going to make the mobile menu button explicitly target the drawer with ARIA state and adjust the smoke test to verify the mobile drawer flow directly after a fresh mobile page load.
